class: Current-employee questions lack dedicated temporal scope
symptom: ADP's current employee of this employer or its affiliates question remained unanswered. Related regression cases also answered Yes for a former employer when asked about current employment.
root_cause: The employment question recognizer misses current employee of an organisation, while its named-current-employee fallback asks a past-work-history question. Thus known current-employer evidence is unused or former employment is substituted for current employment.
why_tests_missed: Employment-history tests primarily ask about ever/former employment and do not contrast current employment against a former employer or a missing current-employer fact.
fix: Recognize current/active employee questions in the shared employment module and resolve them only from the stated current employer. The answer engine handles that scope before historical ties; missing current-employer evidence remains unanswered and relative-employment questions are separate.
prevention: Represent the temporal scope of personal-history questions explicitly. Include current, former, missing-evidence and third-person cases in every employment-answer regression set.
